envelope.streamId: random opaque UUID per local owner/consent generation; NOT derived from account/device/person; not freshness evidence
envelope.revision: positive safe integer, durably increasing within stream; full replacement, not patch
envelope.generatedAtEpochMs: original query epoch milliseconds; positive integer, not future; never receipt/render time
envelope.validUntilEpochMs: original source envelope deadline; no extension
envelope.metrics: object keyed by allowlisted metrics; each has state, optional integer value, validUntilEpochMs
envelope.kind: snapshot | revoked; revoked is value-free tombstone, metrics={}, validUntilEpochMs=0, no positive freshness window required; stream/revision fences still required

semantics: v2 initial scope only four source-proven metrics; no heart/HRV/narrative/derived labels without separately proven validity; no routine/operational changes

Missing metric is unavailable. Nonvalid states omit value and use validUntilEpochMs=0. States allowed: valid,no_data,expired,sample_time_unknown,revoked,permission_denied,invalid. Unknown state means unavailable.

Valid requires actual JSON finite integer within range, value present, both envelope and metric deadlines strictly greater than now, metric deadline<=envelope deadline, generatedAt<=now. No string coercion, fractional truncation or clamp. Zero valid is displayed as zero.

Malformed metric replaces that metric with unavailable/invalid while other independently valid metrics survive. Never retain prior value. Structural envelope/schema/control errors reject whole snapshot and clear CrewLife values, while preserving replay high-watermark.
Every accepted revision replaces entire snapshot. Expiry re-evaluated on load, open Activity, AOD/complication/render; no TTL renewal. Exact expiry unavailable '--'.
Reject unknown/prohibited envelope/metric fields recursively; no raw series, identity, account ID, location, tokens, labels or free text. Only transport stream nonce and revision allowed.

Source query TTL and per-sample provenance remain enforced at phone; Wire generatedAt is not proof of sample age. Phone must transport per-metric deadlines from sanitizer; cannot reconstruct from receipt.
handshake: Before reset, phone sends directed {schemaVersion:2,op:challenge_request,action:reset|revoke,streamId,revision,requestId}. This has no authority to activate a stream or restore values.

Wear creates unpredictable SecureRandom 256-bit wearChallenge, persists one pending tuple {sourcePhoneNode,action,streamId,revision,requestId,wearChallenge,consumed:false} before responding. Missing/lost/corrupt journal starts unavailable, clears CrewLife cache and creates a fresh nonce. Never accepts a nonce supplied by reset itself.

Wear responds via ACK path {schemaVersion:2,op:challenge,action,streamId,revision,requestId,wearChallenge}. Phone accepts only exact currently pending node/action/stream/revision/requestId and live local owner/consent generation, commits the received challenge before sending reset/revoke.

Phone sends {schemaVersion:2,op:reset|revoke,streamId,revision,requestId,wearChallenge}. Wear requires exact durable pending tuple, authenticated DataLayer sender node and unused challenge. No pending challenge => reject; unknown/lost journal => reject reset, initiate fresh exchange.

Reset atomically clears CrewLife cache, installs stream/revision fence and consumes challenge durably before ACK. ACK {schemaVersion:2,op:reset_ack|revoke_ack,streamId,revision,requestId,wearChallenge,status:cleared}. Failed commit => unavailable/no ACK.

Duplicate exact already-applied request may ACK idempotently only against its durable applied receipt, without clearing newer values or lowering the current revision. A consumed old challenge cannot authorize a different stream/revision or replay after subsequent reset.

Phone validates ACK against both its pending challenge and current owner/consent generation. Presence of capability, local API success, arbitrary challenge responses, missing wearChallenge or replayed old reset ACK cannot release readiness.

Pending challenge may be replaced by a newly received challenge_request without changing active stream. Delayed old hello can only cause handshake retry/availability loss, never activation. Use bounded retries; no clock ordering authority.

Revocation remains immediate locally; matching active-stream higher-revision tombstone may only clear values, never establish a stream. Cleanup ACK requires challenged exchange. Unknown-stream tombstone must not reset current stream/fences. Persistent tombstone is retained while ACK is pending.

No clock-based nonce freshness. On actual journal loss, restart nonce must be unpredictable and distinct; prior stream UUID allow/deny history is not relied upon. Random-source or persistence failure stays unavailable.
revocation: Owner change/logout, consent withdrawal, provider disconnect/empty/revoked summary immediately invalidate phone generation and cancel/ignore pending work; stop values before transport cleanup.

Advance persistent revision in current stream; send durable v2 unavailable/revoked tombstone full replacement with no values and retain until all intended v2 peers ACK cleanup. Delete legacy v1 health item. Do not delete tombstone before ACK; retry on reconnect/process restart with bounded backoff.

Reset/revoke ACK only after Wear health cache cleared durably and high-water fence persisted. Expired/replayed lower/equal conflicting revision cannot restore values. Regrant/new owner needs new opaque stream plus fresh reset ACK.

Routine is NOT deleted by CrewLife protocol migration or category-specific health invalidation. Existing explicit revoke-all routine behavior remains separate and must be tested, not silently changed.

Uninstall/reset/loss of sender journal or new node requires handshake again. Old phone+old watch remains unfixed; old phone+new watch v1 replay remains unavailable. Release remains blocked where legacy remote cache cleanup cannot be proved.

add: lower revision replay and duplicate idempotency
offline legacy cache not falsely confirmed
delete API success without Wear ACK
malformed full replacement cannot retain old metric
wearChallenge: old reset+old data delivered after Wear journal loss rejected before fresh challenge
old hello delivered after loss issues NEW nonce; old phone reset nonce mismatch rejected
old challenge response reaches current phone but requestId/stream/generation mismatch => ignored
wear journal lost after challenge output but before reset => old reset rejected; new exchange required
phone journal lost while reset in flight => no previous pending ACK authority; fresh handshake
exact duplicate reset idempotent; never clears higher-revision data
consumed old challenge cannot reactivate stream after another reset
logout/consent revoked between challenge, persist, reset send, ACK and put => no values
crash/commit failure at pending challenge, consumed marker, cache clear, ACK journal => unavailable/no false success
delayed old challenge_request may force retry but cannot change active stream
revoked tombstone never bootstraps unknown stream; old tombstone cannot roll back current generation

hold: Exact-head CI and independent review of receiver challenge implementation
Joint phone/Wear composition and current sender generation/consent/pending ACK tests
HealthSync OFF; no SDK, new permissions, real health data or store action
MCC shared integration gate remains separate
implementationScope: Wear only; phone owner implements sender/capability and pending cleanup journal separately
challengeEncoding: wearChallenge: opaque lowercase hexadecimal string of64characters encoding SecureRandom256bits; phone echoes exact string, never generates it
